resolvedFailures.name: enum-binding-dynamic-nan
resolvedFailures.priorCause: Nonfinite compatibility rewriting still treats a lexically bound nonliteral NaN as an enum member. Native binding facts currently cover primitive initializers only. Upstream OXC also special-cases NaN before binding resolution.

resolvedFailures.name: enum-binding-dynamic-infinity
resolvedFailures.priorCause: The same nonfinite/name-versus-binding defect for nonliteral Infinity; this changes runtime meaning and purity annotation.

resolvedFailures.name: enum-binding-after
resolvedFailures.priorCause: The scope facts currently require declaration before use. Pinned Babel folds this later initializer anyway; preserving Babel output requires its actual static binding-folding behavior, regardless of tsc/TDZ expectations.

resolvedFailures.name: enum-binding-computed
resolvedFailures.priorCause: Rust scope facts resolve direct primitive initializers but not recursive constant arithmetic initializers.

resolvedFailures.name: enum-binding-alias
resolvedFailures.priorCause: Recursive stable binding aliases are not folded by the present scope facts.

resolvedFailures.name: enum-binding-negative
resolvedFailures.priorCause: A unary negative initializer is not a direct NumericLiteral in the present facts collector.

resolvedFailures.name: enum-template-interpolation
resolvedFailures.priorCause: OXC 0.58 enum evaluator concatenates template quasis but ignores interpolation expressions. A correct native static template fold/lowering seam remains required.

resolvedFailures.name: enum-string-concat-auto
resolvedFailures.priorCause: The native Babel guard rejects auto-increment after a direct string initializer, but not after a string constant expression. Pinned Babel rejects both.
